text: “We were playing Elaine,” explained Anne frigidly, without even looking at her rescuer, “and I had to drift down to Camelot in the barge--I mean the flat. The flat began to leak and I climbed out on the pile. The girls went for help. Will you be kind enough to row me to the landing?” Gilbert obligingly rowed to the landing and Anne, disdaining assistance, sprang nimbly on shore. “I’m very much obliged to you,” she said haughtily as she turned away.
